name: [ 기초영어회화 ] 저는 사람 이름을 잘 기억 못해요 😅

keywords.en: I’m not very good at remembering names.

keywords.ko: (sth)을 수행하는 능력이 떨어진다. 잘못한다. (at뒤에는 행동이 나와야한다.math/sports 종목같은것도)

keywords.en: I’m not good at using computers
keywords.ko: 컴퓨터를 잘 못한다. (computer라는 단어로만 표현할 수 없다. 행동이 아니라 →using computers)

keywords.en: When I taught students at language institutes, I often got the students name mixed up.
keywords.ko: 어학원에서 학생들을 가르칠 때 학생들의 이름을 자주 혼동했어요.

keywords.en: I got the dates mixed up
It usually took me a while to remember their names correctly
keywords.ko: 학생들의 이름을 맞게 기억하는 데는 시간이 좀 걸렸어요.

keywords.en: It usually takes me a while to ___
I’m not very good at remembering names
When I taught students at language institutes, I often got the student’s names mixed up
It usually took me a while to remember their names correctly.

my_sentences.ko: 1. be good at + 행위/분야 (-을 잘하다)

my_sentences.en: She is really good at negotiating prices.
my_sentences.ko: (그녀는 가격 협상을 정말 잘한다.)

my_sentences.en: I'm not good at multitasking.
my_sentences.ko: (저는 여러 일을 동시에 잘 못해요.)

my_sentences.en: He was always good at math in high school.
my_sentences.ko: (그는 고등학교 때 항상 수학을 잘했다.)

my_sentences.en: Are you good at public speaking?
my_sentences.ko: (너 대중 앞에서 말 잘해?)
2. be good with + 대상/도구 (-을 잘 다루다/상대하다)

my_sentences.en: My brother is very good with his hands.
my_sentences.ko: (내 남동생은 손재주가 좋다/손으로 만드는 걸 잘 다룬다.)

my_sentences.en: You need someone who is good with difficult customers.
my_sentences.ko: (까다로운 손님을 잘 다루는 사람이 필요해요.)

my_sentences.en: I’ve never been good with numbers.
my_sentences.ko: (저는 원래 숫자/회계/계산에 약해요.)

my_sentences.en: Dogs love her because she is good with animals.
my_sentences.ko: (그녀가 동물을 잘 다뤄서 개들이 그녀를 좋아한다.)
3. get (things) mixed up (뒤섞이다, 혼동하다)

my_sentences.en: I always get their names mixed up because they are twins.
my_sentences.ko: (그들이 쌍둥이라 난 항상 이름을 헷갈려.)

my_sentences.en: Sorry, I got the meeting rooms mixed up.
my_sentences.ko: (죄송해요, 회의실을 착각했습니다.)
bold_words: got the meeting rooms mixed up

my_sentences.en: Did you get the addresses mixed up?
my_sentences.ko: (너 주소 혼동한 거 아니야?)

my_sentences.en: My travel documents got all mixed up in my bag.
my_sentences.ko: (내 여행 서류들이 가방 안에서 다 뒤섞여버렸다.)

my_sentences.en: Oh no, I got the days mixed up. I'll head over right now!
my_sentences.ko: (아이고, 내가 요일을 혼동했네. 지금 바로 갈게!)
4. It takes (someone) a while to... (-하는 데 시간이 좀 걸리다)

my_sentences.en: It took me a while to get used to driving here.
my_sentences.ko: (여기서 운전하는 데 익숙해지는 데 시간이 좀 걸렸어.)
bold_words: It took me a while to get used to

my_sentences.en: It usually takes him a while to reply to messages.
my_sentences.ko: (그는 보통 메시지 답장하는 데 시간이 좀 걸린다.)
bold_words: It usually takes him a while to reply

my_sentences.en: It takes a while to build trust with new clients.
my_sentences.ko: (새 고객과 신뢰를 쌓는 데는 시간이 좀 걸린다.)
bold_words: It takes a while to build

my_sentences.en: Don't worry, it takes a while to learn the system.
my_sentences.ko: (걱정 마, 시스템 익히는 데는 원래 시간이 좀 걸려.)
bold_words: it takes a while to learn

my_sentences.en: A: Nice to meet you, Jason! Wait, or is it Justin?
my_sentences.ko: [상황 1. 직장에서 처음 만난 동료들과 인사할 때 (이름/얼굴 기억)]

my_sentences.en: B: It's Jason! Don't worry about it.
A: Sorry about that, I’m not very good at remembering names. It usually takes me a while to connect names with faces.
my_sentences.ko: (죄송해요, 제가 이름을 잘 기억 못 해서요. 얼굴이랑 이름 매치시키는 데 시간이 좀 걸려요.)
bold_words: I’m not very good at remembering names
It usually takes me a while to

my_sentences.ko: [상황 2. 새로운 소프트웨어나 도구를 다루는 업무 중]

my_sentences.en: A: Can you help me format this spreadsheet? I’m not really good with Excel.
my_sentences.ko: (이 스프레드시트 서식 맞추는 것 좀 도와줄래? 나 엑셀 다루는 데는 영 젬병이라.)
bold_words: I’m not really good with Excel

my_sentences.en: B: Sure! I’m pretty good at using shortcut keys, so let me take a look.
my_sentences.ko: (그럼! 나 단축키 쓰는 건 꽤 잘하니까, 내가 한번 볼게.)

my_sentences.en: A: How are you finding the new office?
my_sentences.ko: [상황 3.  새로운 동네나 직장에 적응할 때]

my_sentences.en: B: The team is great, but the workflow is confusing. It will take me a while to get the hang of it.
my_sentences.ko: (팀은 좋은데 업무 흐름이 헷갈려. 손에 익는 데 시간이 좀 걸릴 것 같아.)
bold_words: It will take me a while to get the hang of it
